episodes.156287: Shortwave disturbance over Mid-South/Tennessee Valley region and attendant surface low with cold front extending south into the Gulf of Mexico produced a mesoscale convective system (MCS) ahead of the front that moved across the eastern gulf into West-Central and Southwest Florida, spawning a tornado and multiple, separate wind damage reports along with hail. One indirect fatality resulted when a motorist exited a vehicle due to a downed tree and inadvertently contacted a live power line.
episodes.156291: Shortwave disturbance over Mid-South/Tennessee Valley region and attendant surface low with cold front extending south into the Gulf of Mexico produced a mesoscale convective system (MCS) ahead of the front that moved across the eastern Gulf of Mexico, producing  numerous strong marine wind gusts as it pushed across the coastal waters.
episodes.156743: A band of strong storms formed near the I-10 corridor during the early morning hours and tracked southward across northeast Florida through mid afternoon. Steep mid level lapse rates in the 7-8 C/km and cold temperatures aloft produced marginally severe hail, rainfall rates of 2+ inches per hour, and gusty winds in the 40-60 mph range over a unstable early morning airmass with surface CAPEs of 2000-2500 J/kg across NE FL.
episodes.156744: A band of strong storms formed near the I-10 corridor during the early morning hours and tracked southward across northeast Florida through mid afternoon. Steep mid level lapse rates in the 7-8 C/km and cold temperatures aloft produced marginally severe hail, rainfall rates of 2+ inches per hour, and gusty winds in the 40-60 mph range over a unstable early morning airmass with surface CAPEs of 2000-2500 J/kg across NE FL.
episodes.156910: Widespread thunderstorms pushed across all of east-central Florida, with many producing strong wind gusts along the coast.
episodes.156920: A squall line associated with the leading edge of a mesoscale convective system moved across all of central and south Florida. The system produced numerous strong winds gusts along the coast, including up to hurricane-force.
episodes.156931: A squall line associated with a mesoscale convective system moved across all of central and south Florida. One storm produced large hail in Orange and Seminole Counties, while a line of severe thunderstorms produced very strong wind gusts along the Treasure Coast, and wind damage in Martin County.
episodes.157115: A shortwave trough moving over the eastern Gulf of Mexico developed a mesoscale convective complex that moved through South Florida.  Environmental parameters were favorable for the development of strong to severe storms, which produced hail and damaging winds across the east coast metro areas of South Florida.||A total of 63,147 customers lost power during this event. Following is the breakdown by county: Palm Beach 33,136, Broward 11,572, Miami-Dade 18,439.
episodes.157116: A shortwave trough moving over the eastern Gulf of Mexico developed a mesoscale convective complex that moved through South Florida. Environmental parameters were favorable for the development of strong to severe storms, which produced gusty winds over the Gulf waters before moving onshore.
episodes.157117: A shortwave trough moving over the eastern Gulf of Mexico developed a mesoscale convective complex that moved through South Florida. Environmental parameters were favorable for the development of strong to severe storms, which produced a waterspout and gusty winds as they moved offshore into the Atlantic waters.
episodes.157186: Multiple round of showers and thunderstorms ahead of a strong cold front affected the tri-state region during the April 9-10 period. A squall line pushed through on April 10th with wind gusts in excess of 34 knots measured along the Florida panhandle coast.
episodes.157897: Isolated storms formed in modest instability, mainly producing strong gusty winds.
episodes.158176: Heavy rain brought localized flooding to Fulton County on Sunday April 11th.  Flooding on Licking Creek in Needmore, PA resulted in one fatality when a man drove over a flooded bridge.
episodes.158230: Scattered gale-force wind gusts occurred with thunderstorms developing during the early morning hours of April 11, 2021, in the veering southerly flow ahead of a cold front moving quickly southeast through the northeast Gulf of Mexico.
episodes.158231: A large mesoscale convective system propagating southward from the central Florida peninsula initiated a large outflow boundary that pushed southward throughout the Florida Keys.  Widespread gale-force wind gusts, especially across the coastal waters of the upper and middle Florida Keys, resulted.
episodes.158235: Strong winds associated with thunderstorms moving south along a large outflow boundary produced isolated non-structural wind damage in Key Largo.
episodes.158311: A line of heavy rain showers and thunderstorms moved over the North Carolina foothills during the late afternoon and evening in advance of a cold front. A couple of areas of isolated damaging winds along with weak tornadoes were reported as the line swept across the area.
